static_algorithm_audit.observed_pattern: Single shared `deadline` (time.monotonic()-based) across all REQUIRED_COMPONENTS. Each outer while-loop iteration calls `_node_list()` once (bounded by `remaining` time), then iterates REQUIRED_COMPONENTS in a fixed tuple order (map_server, planner_server, controller_server, collision_monitor, behavior_server, bt_navigator, waypoint_follower), and for each discovered component calls `_lifecycle_get()` sequentially, each call consuming a slice of the *same* shared deadline (`remaining2 = deadline - time.monotonic()`).
static_algorithm_audit.consistency_with_2H24_failure_signatures: In 2H.2.4 attempt_3, controller_server (3rd in REQUIRED_COMPONENTS order) failed with LIFECYCLE_QUERY_FAILED and waypoint_follower (7th/last) failed with NOT_ACTIVE -- both consistent with a component late in iteration order being starved of remaining deadline budget by earlier sequential lifecycle queries in the same pass. In extra_2, all 7 components were NOT_DISCOVERED, consistent with `_node_list()` itself timing out or returning incomplete results under heavy concurrent ROS2 daemon load (24-28 cumulative Nav2 bring-ups across the session), not specifically an ordering defect.
candidate_defects_visible_in_source: shared deadline consumed sequentially across components within one discovery pass (visible at line 933: `lifecycle_timeout = min(5.0, max(0.5, remaining2))`)

discovery (_node_list) and lifecycle query (_lifecycle_get) are interleaved per-component rather than batched, so a slow lifecycle_get for component N reduces the time budget available to query component N+1's lifecycle state in the same pass (though the outer while loop does retry on the next 1.0s-sleep iteration, so this is mitigated across iterations, not within one)

The static source-code audit above is consistent with, but does not prove, a shared-deadline/sequential-query defect; per Section 12 this must not be escalated to a PROVEN_* classification without a failing, reproducible test. The historical ENVIRONMENTAL_TRANSIENT classification recorded in the 2H.2.4 report is explicitly disallowed as a proven-cause label under 2H.2.5 criteria and is downgraded to OBSERVED_ROOT_CAUSE_NOT_PROVEN as a description of the historical record only -- it is NOT re-asserted as this session's finding, which is the stricter NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_2H25.
fix_rationale: No fix was applied. Per Section 12 a defect may only be corrected if (1) it can be reproduced deterministically, (2) a failing test exists first, (3) the correction is confined to the harness, (4) no assertions are relaxed to obtain green. Condition (1) and (2) cannot be satisfied without a ROS2 environment, so no correction was attempted.
